verdict.rationale: RUN documents exporting payroll journal entries into QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions, or a generic output file, which gives an agent an export path to reconcile into a ledger. ADP's separately purchased API Central offers OAuth-secured APIs and use-case templates, but nothing in the evidence ties it to RUN journal or general-ledger data. missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for payroll journal/GL data in RUN, agent-oriented or automated pull of journal exports, any reconciliation tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
